claim_1.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of whole blood or cryopreserved PBMCs from young adults (25–40 years; n=13 for CD8+) and elderly adults (60–79 years; n=19 for CD8+) sampled at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, 7, 14, 28, 90 and 180 after Zostavax® vaccination, showed a weak CD8+ T cell response in peripheral blood as measured by Ki67+Bcl2- compared to the responses seen with other live vaccines.

sources.quote: Since Zostavax® comprises a live-attenuated virus, we were surprised to observe a weak CD8+ T cell response in peripheral blood, as measured by the downregulation of the pro-survival molecule (Bcl2) and upregulation of Ki67 (expressed in proliferating cells, (Miller et al., 2008) (Figure 1B), unlike the robust CD8+ T cell responses seen with other live vaccines such as yellow fever and smallpox (Akondy et al., 2009; Miller et al., 2008).

B) CD8+ and CD4+ T cell activation as measured by Ki67+Bcl2- in young adults (black, n=13 for CD8+, n=15 for CD4+) and the elderly (orange, n=19 for CD8+, n=21 for CD4+). Mean values in solid lines, and shades for 90% confidence interval.

claim_2.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of whole blood or cryopreserved PBMCs from young adults (25–40 years; n=15 for CD4+) and elderly adults (60–79 years; n=21 for CD4+) sampled at baseline (day 0) and days 1, 3, 7, 14, 28, 90 and 180 after Zostavax® vaccination, showed that significant CD4+ T cell responses were detected in the majority of subjects compared to baseline.

sources.quote: In contrast significant CD4+ T cell responses were detected in the majority of subjects (Figure 1B), consistent with a recent report (Qi et al., 2016).

B) CD8+ and CD4+ T cell activation as measured by Ki67+Bcl2- in young adults (black, n=13 for CD8+, n=15 for CD4+) and the elderly (orange, n=19 for CD8+, n=21 for CD4+). Mean values in solid lines, and shades for 90% confidence interval.

claim_3.claim: Flow cytometry analysis of cryopreserved PBMCs from young adults (25 to 40 years; n=16) and elderly adults (60 to 79 years; n=20) sampled at baseline and post-vaccination timepoints after Zostavax® vaccination, showed an increase in CD4+CXCR5+CXCR3+ICOS+ T cells in both age groups compared to baseline.

sources.quote: Figure 1C shows an increase in CD4+CXCR5+CXCR3+ICOS+ T cells after Zostavax® in both the young and elderly adults.
C) Increase in VZV-specific Tfh-like cells (as measured by CXCR5+ICOS+CXCR3+) in young adults (n=16) and the elderly (n=20).

claim_4.claim: ELISPOT analysis of cryopreserved PBMCs from young adults (25 to 40 years; n=17) and elderly adults (60 to 79 years; n=22) sampled at baseline and post-vaccination timepoints after Zostavax® vaccination, showed significant increases in IFN-γ+, IL-4+, and IL-21+ CD4+ T cells compared to baseline.

sources.quote: Significant increase in CD4+ T cells that are positive for IFN-γ, IL-4 and IL-21 were also detected, indicating a mixed Th1/Th2/Th21 profile (Figure 1C).

C) Increase in VZV-specific Tfh-like cells (as measured by CXCR5+ICOS+CXCR3+) in young adults (n=16) and the elderly (n=20). Antigen-specific IFN-γ, IL-4 or IL-21 production by CD4+ T cells as measured by ELISPOT in young adults (n=17) and the elderly (n=22). SFC = Spot forming cells.

claim_38.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMCs from 77 subjects vaccinated with Zostavax®, using variance analysis with weighted average of the variance captured by the first five principal components, showed that BCR signaling, phosphatidylinositol signaling, and inositol phosphate metabolism were among the top contributing data types to the day 7/0 transcriptome in the candidate set of data types explaining variance.

sources.quote: Indeed, when we examined the contributing factors to the day 7/0 transcriptome by variance analysis (Nath et al., 2012), BCR signaling, phosphatidylinositol signaling and inositol phosphate metabolism were on the top of the list, besides house-keeping genes such as mRNA processing (Figure 7A).
A) Percent of variance in the day 7/0 transcriptome explained by each data types, using weighted average of the variance captured by the first five principal components (Nath et al., 2012).

claim_39.claim: DNA microarray analysis of PBMCs from 77 subjects vaccinated with Zostavax® showed that PSPH expression at day 3/0 was correlated with baseline inositol phosphate metabolism (M129) in the cohort.

sources.quote: However, a closer examination revealed a dichotomous pattern: for the majority of subjects, the expression of PSPH gene at day 3/0 displayed a linear correlation with the baseline gene module on IP metabolism (blue dots in Figure 7C), but a subset of subjects had a hyper-upregulation of PSPH over 23 folds (orange dots in Figure 7C).

sources.quote: When we examined the association of all nodes in the full MMRN, while 9% was significant for age and 21% for sex, 67% (608/909) of MMRN was significantly associated with IP metabolism (Figure 7G).
